# Iron Vow Rig Bench credits

| Item | Source | Rights |
|---|---|---|
| Warden geometry, paint, stencil lettering, normal and ORM maps | Original work created for this brief.  | Original project assets. No upstream asset license. |
| Kestrel, Hailstorm, Longbow, Breaker, Cleaver and Piledriver | Original work created for this brief.  | Original project assets. No upstream asset license. |
| Rig Bench, hangar, procedural fallback, effects, audio and controls | User-supplied `iron-vow-rig.html`, with this package's GLB integration. | Existing project material. |
| three.js r128 and GLTFLoader | [three.js r128](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128), exact r128 scripts served from this bench’s vendor directory. | [MIT](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r128/LICENSE) |

The production meshes and textures contain no external geometry, textures, fonts, or kitbash assets. The Warden was built from the written brief.
